scheduler.observation: Which scheduler runs propfirm tick, its cron expression, and the URL or log of the check run

network_access.observation: The check run reached api.propr.xyz (authenticated read) and api.hyperliquid.xyz from the scheduler

persistent_state.observation: Where PROPFIRM_HOME persists between runs, for example committed to the private repository

private_secrets.observation: How PROPR_API_KEY reaches the tick without appearing in files, logs or chat
